guides.title: How to Build Listening Activities for A1 and A2 Students
guides.description: A guide to designing listening activities that work with beginners, including text selection, pre-teaching, task types, and how to use two-voice dialogues.

guides.title: How to Create Dictation Activities
guides.description: A practical guide to designing dictation activities for ESL classes, including classical, running, partial, and dictogloss variants, with tips on speed and feedback.

guides.title: How to Create Listening Exercises for ESL Students
guides.description: A practical workflow for designing clear, classroom-ready English listening exercises from any text or dialogue, including step-by-step instructions and common pitfalls.

guides.title: How to Practice English Pronunciation with Audio
guides.description: A practical guide to using audio tools and simple drills to improve English pronunciation in class or self-study, focused on stress, intonation, and connected speech.

guides.title: How to Use Text-to-Speech in English Classes
guides.description: When text-to-speech helps ESL teaching and when it does not, with practical classroom patterns for using neural voices for listening, pronunciation, and differentiation.
